answer: Sybil resistance binds identity to a refundable bond that is slashed if one operator is proven to run several agents, so creating N fakes costs N bonds plus forfeiture of all of them when one is caught. Because chatty neighbor agents gossip every shared trace, a whisper of a lagoon of identical behavior triggers an audit voyage that each clone must survive independently. Honest agents post one bond and recover it; attackers pay growth that compounds with scale until cloning is unprofitable.
